correctness.rationale: The normalized nine-function harmonic basis is orthonormal both in continuous spherical L2 and under equal weighting of the twelve explicit vertices, by exact fourth-moment equalities. The row projection kernel has three values: diagonal 3/4, antipodal 1/4, and other off-diagonal ±1/(4√5). Erasure Gram eigenvalues are one minus the eigenvalues of matrices of order at most three, with extra unit eigenvalues. Direct signed-triple and antipodal-block diagonalization proves all displayed eigenvalues and equality cases. The six vertex axes form an equiangular tight frame with a zero-cubic-trace Seidel matrix, giving exactly ten positive and ten negative axis triples; the eight choices of signs give 80+80. The exact 233-of-4096 census follows. The independent construction of the complete 12-by-9 matrix and characteristic-polynomial comparisons for all 299 erasures of size ≤3 produced 1317 supplemental scalar checks; these are finite consistency tests, not infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The exact source configuration is a natural tight spherical five-design with twelve measurements for a nine-dimensional harmonic band. Three erasures is the information-theoretic maximum for full recovery; antipodal symmetry makes even two erasures sometimes fatal, while 160 of 220 maximal erasures remain recoverable. The theorem gives all 4096 rank-success classifications, precise two-type maximal-erasure noise stability and a geometric Seidel-trace explanation of the 80+80 split. This is a motivated sharp finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or known-table recomputation; no generalization to all frames is claimed.
